name: Zensical
description: Zensical is a static site generator for project documentation from the team behind Material for MkDocs, with a Rust core and a Python package that reads MkDocs-style configuration.
notes: Rust core distributed as a Python wheel; benchmarked with a minimal theme override (single main.html via theme.custom_dir) instead of the built-in Material-style theme. Search index and sitemap are always produced by the tool and counted in the output.
